description.value: Small Victory is a family-owned artisan bakery and café whose founders grew up in their parents' Kenyan-immigrant bakery business on West Broadway before launching their own neighbourhood concept. The bakery hand-crafts a full range of laminated pastries, sourdough-style breads, and specialty espresso drinks using beans from rotating local roasters. A touring cyclist will find a warm, community-focused stop with substantial brunch and lunch options alongside fresh bread and pastries to go.
